rationale: Both catch the central substantive bug (double-seeding of num_stale_output_tokens on the replace_streaming_prompt path) with specific file:line evidence; X additionally claims a concrete reproduction trace, which is stronger verification if honest. Neither candidate hits the sparse, mostly-resolved ground-truth concerns (already-fixed utils moves, the open use_all2all style question), so recall is low and roughly tied for both. X edges ahead on precision/clarity: it gives a single consistent verdict and two additional high-value, well-reasoned findings (Qwen2.5-Omni forward-contract regression, generation-stage randomize-dummy-ids escape hatch) that Y never raises. Y's report is also solid and well-cited but internally inconsistent (a 'validated: all three seed sites correct' bullet followed by a 'blocker: double-seed confirmed' on the same mechanism) and includes redundant near-duplicate dead-code findings, slightly hurting clarity and precision.
